characterSheets.prompt: Hattie: a small round hedgehog about the size of an apple, soft brown spines with lighter tips, a cream-coloured tummy and face, a little pink nose, large friendly dark eyes with a white sparkle, rosy cheeks, short legs and tiny paws; round and soft proportions; expressions range from wide-eyed excitement to a sleepy smile.
